goal_intent: book a table for two, then change your mind and say it is four

turns.utterance: Hi there, I'm ringing to book a table for this weekend, as we're planning a little get-together and I'd love to make sure we have a spot.
It’ll just be two of us to start with—my friend and I are catching up after ages. Could you book us in for Saturday evening?
Let’s go for 7pm, that’s perfect for dinner after a stroll if the weather’s nice. My name’s Neve Ashworth—hopefully that’s enough to hold the reservation!

Oh wait, I just realised two more friends are joining us—so it’ll actually be four of us in total! Sorry for the mix-up. No special requests, just a table for four under my name, Neve Ashworth, for Saturday at 7pm.

That sounds absolutely lovely, thank you! We’re all looking forward to it, and the window seat is a nice touch. That’s all for now—have a great day! 

[END OF CALL]
